name: smwmusic-clock-tower-i-m-looking-for-mary
title: Clock Tower - I'm Looking for Mary
description:
Sampled port of the song that plays after Lotte suggests that should her go look for Ms. Mary, and Jennifer does this instead.

My first port that is both sampled and that uses echo.

Fits dark, haunted and ghost house levels, especially if the player or someone is looking for something.

Update: Added $FA $02 after #0 and the last note's duration is now 16 to make it loop cleanly.
